title: Projet Gordes: digital edition of the correspondence received by Bertrand de Simiane, baron de Gordes (1565-1576)
institution: Université Sorbonne Paris Nord (PLÉIADE) with University of Sheffield, Institut de France and Archives du château de Chantilly
notes:
Participatory digital edition of letters received by the baron de Gordes during the first French Wars of Religion: 1,771 letters and documents in 9 volumes consultable online (source: project homepage), drawn from a fonds of 7,018 letters in 31 volumes (Chantilly, Archives du domaine de Chantilly, série K). Transcriptions with facsimiles and documentary apparatus are freely accessible; no downloadable TEI files found, so encoding recorded as html. Word count not published.

Justification: A freely accessible, actively maintained scholarly edition of transcribed 16th-century manuscript correspondence, squarely within 1450-1700 and not in the catalogue. Found via a general web search for new French-language digital editions of 16th-century correspondence.
Found at: https://www.projetgordes.fr/1/accueil
